Loading Original Dataset

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import (KaplanMeierFitter,
WeibullAFTFitter, 
LogNormalAFTFitter, 
LogLogisticAFTFitter,
WeibullFitter,
LogNormalFitter,
LogLogisticFitter
)
from lifelines.utils import k_fold_cross_validation
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test
from lifelines.plotting import qq_plot
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score
complaints = pd.read_csv('../Data/complaints_dummy_variables.csv')
complaints['closed_status'] = complaints['Date/Time Closed'].notnull()
complaints['closed_status'] = complaints['closed_status'].astype(int)
complaints['Date/Time Opened'] = pd.to_datetime(complaints['Date/Time Opened'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
complaints['Date/Time Closed'] = pd.to_datetime(complaints['Date/Time Closed'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
complaints['completion_duration'] = complaints['Date/Time Closed'] - complaints['Date/Time Opened']
complaints['completion_duration'] = complaints['completion_duration'].dt.total_seconds()/86400
complaints['description_blank'] = complaints['description_quality'].isna().astype(int)
complaints['description_quality'] = complaints['description_quality'] + 1
complaints['description_quality'] = complaints['description_quality'].fillna(0)
complaints = pd.get_dummies(complaints, columns = ['description_quality'], dtype = int)
commplaints = complaints.drop(columns = 'description_quality_0.0', inplace = True)
complaints = complaints.rename(columns = {'Unclear':'ambiguous_primary'})
plt.hist(complaints['completion_duration'], color = 'mediumturquoise', edgecolor = 'blue')
plt.xlabel('Completion Duration')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

Creating Survival DataFrame

complaints['Date/Time Closed'].max()
Timestamp('2026-07-17 11:31:00')
survival_df = complaints.copy()
survival_df['Date/Time Opened'] = pd.to_datetime(
    survival_df['Date/Time Opened'])
survival_df['Date/Time Closed'] = pd.to_datetime(
    survival_df['Date/Time Closed'])

cutoff = pd.Timestamp('2026-07-17 11:31:00')
survival_df['event_observed'] = (
    survival_df['Date/Time Closed'].notna().astype(int))
survival_df['end_time'] = (
    survival_df['Date/Time Closed'].fillna(cutoff))
survival_df['days_open'] = (
    survival_df['end_time'] - survival_df['Date/Time Opened']).dt.total_seconds()/86400

Kaplan-Meier Diagnostic

km = KaplanMeierFitter()
km.fit(survival_df['days_open'], event_observed=survival_df['event_observed'])
km.plot_survival_function()
km.median_survival_time_
# shading around curve shows uncertainty/confidence interval
np.float64(39.84513888888889)

Model 1

Creation

complaints.columns
Index(['Date/Time Opened', 'Date/Time Closed', 'break_deduction',

Kaplan-Meier Diagnostics

def km_compare(df, variable):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    for value in [0, 1]:
        group = df[df[variable] == value]
        km = KaplanMeierFitter()
        km.fit(
            group["days_open"],
            event_observed=group["event_observed"],
            label=f"{variable} = {value}"
        )
        km.plot_survival_function(ax=ax)

        print(
            value,
            "median:",
            km.median_survival_time_
        )

    g0 = df[df[variable] == 0]
    g1 = df[df[variable] == 1]

    test = logrank_test(
        g0["days_open"],
        g1["days_open"],
        event_observed_A=g0["event_observed"],
        event_observed_B=g1["event_observed"]
    )

    print("Log-rank p-value:", test.p_value)
    plt.xlabel("Days open")
    plt.ylabel("Probability still open")
    plt.show()

def km_compare2(df, variable):

    medians = []
    for value in [0, 1]:
        group = df[df[variable] == value]
        km = KaplanMeierFitter()
        km.fit(
            group["days_open"],
            event_observed=group["event_observed"],
            label=f"{variable} = {value}"
        )

        m = km.median_survival_time_
        medians.append(m)

    g0 = df[df[variable] == 0]
    g1 = df[df[variable] == 1]

    test = logrank_test(
        g0["days_open"],
        g1["days_open"],
        event_observed_A=g0["event_observed"],
        event_observed_B=g1["event_observed"]
    )

    return (variable, test.p_value)

    score = km_compare2(survival_df, predictors2[i])

    if score[1] <= 0.05:
        good_scores.append(score)
